justification: Inspected gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/sql/SqlTimeTypeAdapter.java, gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/sql/SqlTypesSupport.java, and the sibling adapters SqlDateTypeAdapter.java/SqlTimestampTypeAdapter.java. SqlTimeTypeAdapter is a compact 90-line class with one field, one static factory, and only two behavioral methods (`read`/`write`), all centered on java.sql.Time serialization. It does not show excessive size, many public methods, or multiple responsibilities; it matches the same narrow adapter pattern used by the other SQL type adapters.
